name: Litescrape
summary: Low-cost SERP and web-data API: Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, maps, app stores, review sites and page fetch.

api_key.description: a Litescrape API key (litescrape.com dashboard; new keys include 5 free calls)

notes: Auth is 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. A flat per-request price applies and failed requests cost nothing.
Every endpoint has a GET form with scalar query parameters and a POST form taking JSON; this entry lists the GET form and the most useful parameters, not every one in Litescrape's schema.
Each endpoint has an /async variant for submit-then-poll jobs; see https://litescrape.com/docs/async.
Many more endpoints exist (Amazon, eBay, social, jobs, real estate and others); only the search, app-store, maps, review and web ones are included.

endpoints.name: Google Search

q.description: Google Search query, up to 2,048 characters.

notes: Pass q, or page_token alone for the next page.
Billed per successful call; failed requests are not billed.
Every endpoint also has an /async variant (submit, then poll); this entry uses the synchronous GET.
